A '''pirate base''' was located in the [[Aethrorn Mountains]] on [[Jagomir]]. Sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of pirates operated out of the base. By the time [[Resolute Base]] was built nearby, it had been abandoned and was falling into disrepair.<ref name="OAA1" />
